changelog.name: v2.1.0
changelog.body:
## What's Changed



### 🚀 Added

- [`f239675`](https://github.com/hxreborn/cleanshare/commit/f2396752dba9f613f16b587de805bdcb6e8fe7a6) - *(deletion)* Add trash as alternative to permanent delete by @hxreborn

  Add new mode to move screenshots to trash alongside permanent delete. Defaults to trash.

- [`d22edd1`](https://github.com/hxreborn/cleanshare/commit/d22edd1121bca6399d111b9d070f3991092c594e) - *(hook)* Detect edited screenshots via IPC resolution by @hxreborn

  Add async method to detect recently edited screenshots so they're offered to delete.


### 🐛 Fixed

- [`47f23df`](https://github.com/hxreborn/cleanshare/commit/47f23dfcd31231e998940611973c1c4cfbb6d9d1) - *(hook)* Skip trashed files in screenshot detection by @hxreborn

- [`4ad0b1f`](https://github.com/hxreborn/cleanshare/commit/4ad0b1fe04a6b51ddb35abb0901983583c92c22d) - *(hook)* Reset share session state on each chooser open by @hxreborn

  Prevent stale deletion state from leaking into subsequent share sessions.


### ♻️ Changed

- [`9cfcc45`](https://github.com/hxreborn/cleanshare/commit/9cfcc45db2e536bb4180fe4f4de73fad47fb0252) - *(quickshare)* Gate debug logs behind BuildConfig.DEBUG by @hxreborn

  Revert verbose diagnostic logging from hook mechanism. All QuickShareFilterHooker logs now use debugLog which only emits in debug builds. Removed unused findMethodsByName and formatMethodSig utilities.

- [`a5231d9`](https://github.com/hxreborn/cleanshare/commit/a5231d9760227ce292bb1970efdc5b8f0be87f89) - *(ui)* Improve preference summaries by @hxreborn

readme:
# CleanShare

Xposed module that removes Direct Share's suggested contact/conversation shortcuts from Android's Share Sheet.

## About Direct Share suggests contacts you emailed once five years ago, colleagues from jobs you no longer have, and people you'd rather not be reminded of. The suggestions are [rarely useful](https://support.google.com/android/thread/153774734). I've yet to hit a case where they helped. Might as well cut the row and skip the hassle. CleanShare tricks the Share Sheet into thinking it's running on a low-RAM device. Android then skips the Direct Share pipeline to save resources, so the row never loads. On devices with [Android System Intelligence](https://www.androidpolice.com/what-is-android-system-intelligence/), it also blocks backend shortcut queries to prevent share target profiling. ## Features - Hide Direct Share suggestions from the share sheet - Block share target profiling via Android System Intelligence - Hide Quick Share / Nearby Share from share sheet results - Filter share targets: hide selected apps, or show only the ones you pick - Delete shared screenshots after sharing with configurable delay (root required) - Move to trash or permanently delete - Status card showing whether the module is active and which framework runs it - Add the share sheet to the module's scope from the app when it's missing - Light, dark or system theme, with dynamic color on Android 12+ - About screen with What's new, the full changelog and a bug report link - Built-in settings app with Material 3 UI ## Requirements - Android 11 (API 30) or higher - An Xposed manager with libxposed API 101 support, such as Vector 2.1 or newer - Pixel or AOSP-based ROM (Other OEMs are untested) ## Installation 1. Download the APK: 2. Install and enable the module in your Xposed manager. 3. Configure the scope: **Android 13+** - Intent Resolver (`com.android.intentresolver`) - Android System Intelligence (`com.google.android.as`) **Android 11-12** - System Framework (`android`) - Android System Intelligence (`com.google.android.as`) 4. Reboot your device. System Framework is only needed if you use the delete-after-share feature. The module checks your Android version and only applies what's needed. ## FAQ
What does "Move to trash" do? It uses Android's standard [MediaStore trash](https://developer.android.com/reference/android/provider/MediaStore#IS_TRASHED). The file gets flagged as trashed but stays on disk for 30 days before Android auto-removes it. You can recover it from the trash in Google Photos, Files by Google, or any gallery app that supports MediaStore trash.
Why doesn't the checkbox appear after editing a screenshot? When you edit a screenshot, the editor creates a temporary copy with a different filename. The module tries to find the original screenshot by querying [MediaStore](https://developer.android.com/reference/android/provider/MediaStore) for recent files in your Screenshots folder, but it depends on the filename matching a configurable pattern. If your device uses a non-standard naming convention, it may not find a match. You can adjust the pattern in settings.
Why is there a delay before deletion? The receiving app needs time to process the shared file. If the file is deleted immediately, the share may fail. The delay is configurable in settings.
Does Quick Share filtering work on all devices? It targets the standard AOSP [IntentResolver](https://cs.android.com/android/platform/superproject/+/main:packages/modules/IntentResolver/) package. Some OEMs (e.g. HyperOS) use heavily modified share sheets with different packages and are currently unsupported.
Quick Share still appears when sharing from app X Some apps (e.g. Firefox) implement their own custom share sheet instead of using Android's native one. CleanShare can only hook the system share sheet (`com.android.intentresolver`). If an app rolls its own, there's nothing the module can do about it.
Do I need root for all features? No. Direct Share hiding and Quick Share filtering work without root. Only the delete-after-share feature requires root because it needs to modify MediaStore entries and delete files outside the app's [storage sandbox](https://developer.android.com/training/data-storage#scoped-storage).
## Build ```bash git clone https://github.com/hxreborn/cleanshare.git cd cleanshare ./gradlew assembleRelease ``` Requires JDK 21 and Android SDK. Configure `local.properties`: ```properties sdk.dir=/path/to/android/sdk # Optional signing RELEASE_STORE_FILE= RELEASE_STORE_PASSWORD= RELEASE_KEY_ALIAS= RELEASE_KEY_PASSWORD= ``` ## License This project is licensed under the GNU General Public License v3.0. See [LICENSE](https://github.com/hxreborn/cleanshare/blob/main/LICENSE) for details.

# 清洁共享 Xpose 模块可从 Android 的共享表中删除 Direct Share 建议的联系人/对话快捷方式。

<图片src="https://img.shields.io/badge/dynamic/toml?url=https%3A%2F%2Fraw.githubusercontent.com%2Fhxreborn%2Fcleanshare%2Fmain%2Fgradle%2Flibs.versions.toml&query=%24.versions.kotlin&label=Kotlin&color=7F52FF&style=flat&logo=kotlin&logoColor=white" alt="科特林" />

## 关于 Direct Share 建议您五年前曾通过电子邮件发送过一次的联系人、您不再工作的同事 以及那些你不想被提醒的人。建议 [很少有用](https://support.google.com/android/thread/153774734)。我还没有接过案子 他们提供帮助的地方。不妨减少行列并跳过麻烦。 CleanShare 欺骗共享表，使其认为它正在低 RAM 设备上运行。 Android 然后会跳过 Direct Share 管道可以节省资源，因此该行永远不会加载。 在设备上 与 [Android 系统智能](https://www.androidpolice.com/what-is-android-system-intelligence/)， 它还会阻止后端快捷方式查询以防止共享目标分析。 ## 特点 - 隐藏共享表中的直接共享建议 - 通过 Android System Intelligence 阻止共享目标分析 - 从共享表结果中隐藏快速共享/附近共享 - 过滤共享目标：隐藏选定的应用程序，或仅显示您选择的应用程序 - 以可配置的延迟共享后删除共享的屏幕截图（需要 root） - 移至垃圾箱或永久删除 - 状态卡显示模块是否处于活动状态以及哪个框架运行它 - 当共享表丢失时，将其添加到应用程序的模块范围中 - 浅色、深色或系统主题，在 Android 12+ 上具有动态颜色 - 关于屏幕，包含新增内容、完整变更日志和错误报告链接 - 带有 Material 3 UI 的内置设置应用程序 ## 要求 - Android 11 (API 30) 或更高版本 - 支持 libxposed API 101 的 Xposed 管理器，例如 Vector 2.1 或更新版本 - 基于 Pixel 或 AOSP 的 ROM（其他 OEM 未经测试） ## 安装 1.下载APK： <一href="http://apps.obtainium.imranr.dev/redirect.html?r=obtainium://app/%7B%22id%22%3A%22eu.hxreborn.cleanshare%22%2C%22url%22%3A%22https%3A%2F%2Fgithub.com%2Fhxreborn%2 Fcleanshare%22%2C%22author%22%3A%22rafareborn%22%2C%22name%22%3A%22CleanShare%22%2C%22additionalSettings%22%3A%22%7B%5C%22includePrereleases%5C%22%3Afalse%7D%22%7D"> 2. 在 Xposed 管理器中安装并启用该模块。 3.配置范围： **安卓 13+** - 意图解析器（`com.android.intentresolver`） - Android 系统智能 (`com.google.android.as`) **安卓11-12** - 系统框架（`android`） - Android 系统智能 (`com.google.android.as`) 4. 重新启动您的设备。 仅当您使用共享后删除功能时才需要系统框架。模块检查 您的 Android 版本，仅应用所需的内容。 ## 常见问题解答 <详情> “移至垃圾箱”有什么作用？ 它使用 Android 的标准 [MediaStore 垃圾](https://developer.android.com/reference/android/provider/MediaStore#IS_TRASHED)。 该文件会被标记为已删除，但会在磁盘上保留 30 天，然后 Android 会自动将其删除。 您可以从 Google 相册、Google 文件或任何图库应用程序中的垃圾箱中恢复它 支持 MediaStore 垃圾箱。 <详情> 为什么编辑屏幕截图后不出现复选框？ 当您编辑屏幕截图时，编辑器会创建一个具有不同文件名的临时副本。的 模块尝试通过查询找到原始屏幕截图 [MediaStore](https://developer.android.com/reference/android/provider/MediaStore) 最近 屏幕截图文件夹中的文件，但这取决于与可配置模式匹配的文件名。 如果您的设备使用非标准命名约定，则可能找不到匹配项。你可以调整 设置中的模式。 <详情> 为什么删除之前会有延迟？ 接收应用程序需要时间来处理共享文件。如果立即删除该文件， 共享可能会失败。延迟可在设置中配置。 <详情> 快速共享过滤是否适用于所有设备？ 它针对标准 AOSP [IntentResolver](https://cs.android.com/android/platform/superproject/+/main:packages/modules/IntentResolver/) 包。一些 OEM（例如 HyperOS）使用经过大量修改的共享表和不同的软件包 并且目前不受支持。 <详情> 从应用程序 X 共享时仍然出现“快速共享” 一些应用程序（例如 Firefox）实现自己的自定义共享表，而不是使用 Android 的本机 一。 CleanShare 只能挂接系统共享表（`com.android.intentresolver`）。如果一个应用程序 自己滚动，模块对此无能为力。 <详情> 所有功能都需要 root 权限吗？ 不需要。直接共享隐藏和快速共享过滤无需 root 即可工作。仅限分享后删除 该功能需要 root，因为它需要修改 MediaStore 条目并删除 MediaStore 之外的文件 应用程序的[存储沙箱](https://developer.android.com/training/data-storage#scoped-storage)。 ## 构建 ````bash git 克隆 https://github.com/hxreborn/cleanshare.git 光盘清理共享 ./gradlew assembleRelease ```` 需要 JDK 21 和 Android SDK。配置`local.properties`： ````属性 sdk.dir=/路径/到/android/sdk # 可选签名 RELEASE_STORE_FILE=<路径/to/keystore.jks> RELEASE_STORE_PASSWORD=<商店密码> RELEASE_KEY_ALIAS=<密钥别名> RELEASE_KEY_PASSWORD=<密钥密码> ```` ## 许可证 该项目根据 GNU 通用公共许可证 v3.0 获得许可。有关详细信息，请参阅[许可证](https://github.com/hxreborn/cleanshare/blob/main/LICENSE)。
